about: What 3.30 changed, from the verified run in run-330.json (tools/make_update.py). Applied by make_guides.py on top of the corrections. Do not edit by hand: fix the research record or add a correction.

syndicate.summary: Jun no longer appears in maps at random. In 3.30 you add Betrayal with a Betrayal Thread at the Map Device, or get free Threads in maps inside the Betrayal Shaped Region. Scarabs were removed, so Reinforcements and Unbreaking are gone, Intervention members now give a trapped stash of one class of Unique items, and the other old scarab chests give a specific Allflame Ember. Rin, Riker, Vorici and Elreon rewards also changed, Catarina always drops one of three Embers, and the Betrayal atlas cluster was reworked.

blight.summary: Blight no longer spawns at random in maps. You now add it with a Blight Thread or by running a map inside a Blight Shaped Region, because scarabs were removed and the Blight atlas cluster was reworked. The number of chests per lane now scales with the map's Atlas Drops, Silver Oil on a Blighted Map gives Item Rarity instead of Quantity, Toxic Sewer, Dark Forest and Orchard left the Atlas, and Carcass and Waste Pool came back. Towers, oils and the Blighted Map encounter itself are not changed in the notes.

delve.summary: 3.30 changes where Sulphite comes from. It no longer spawns at random in maps. Instead, several specific Atlas maps always spawn Sulphite Veins, and those veins always have a guard pack and give more Sulphite. All Delve Atlas clusters, the Refiner's Bargain keystone and both Sulphite Scarabs are gone, and no Delve Thread replaces them, so the guide's Niko, atlas and scarab strategies and tables no longer work. The mine itself is unchanged: the notes list no changes to fossils, resonators, Azurite or the city bosses. The only other Delve changes are that Delve area mods now give Item Rarity and Delve gives fewer fractured items.

incursion.summary: 3.30 reworks the Temple. Atziri replaces the Vaal Omnitect as the boss, Vials no longer drop, and the renamed Cradle of Creation makes a Temple area level 84 with Uber Atziri. The Locus and Doryani's devices now corrupt an item or gem a second time, which makes it Twice Corrupted, and either one can destroy the item. Scarabs are gone and Alva no longer appears by chance, so you add Incursion with Incursion Threads or the Incursion Shaped Region.

expedition.summary: Scarabs are gone and Expedition no longer appears in maps by chance. You now add it with Expedition Threads at the Map Device, or get free Threads in maps inside the Expedition Shaped Region (Astrolabes now move that region to one map). Every scarab loadout, the Astrolabe Dunes and Big Boom setups, and the 3.29 Atlas node advice are out of date. Gwennen's gamble became a coin-flip craft on Rare items paid for with Astragali and Broken Circle Artifacts, Rog's reroll deals were cut, the monster item-quantity Remnant was removed, and Olroth can now drop Heroic Tragedy.

heist.summary: 3.30 removes the Heist Atlas passives and random Smuggler's Caches: caches now always spawn in several specific Atlas maps (not named in the notes), give more Blueprints and Markers, and Blueprints found there can have special implicits without any passive. Rogue's Markers, Contracts and Blueprints left the core drop pool, Whakano sells Contracts (rarely Blueprints) for Gold from level 68, Contracts give more Blueprints, bonus reveals and Marker payouts, and Contract and Blueprint mods now give Item Rarity. Rogue gear and Trinket loot mods were cut, Fragment rewards became Thread rewards, Scarabs are gone, and the experimented bases now also drop outside Heist.

sanctum.summary: The 3.30 notes leave the Sanctum itself almost untouched: the only direct change is that the Gilded Font in the Vaults was moved away from the exit stairs. Around it, Scarabs are gone with no Sanctum Thread to replace them, the Atlas tree was rebuilt with no Sanctum cluster named, some specific maps can now hold a Forbidden Tome chest, and Beyond monsters in Mirages no longer drop Volatile Vaal Orbs.

ultimatum.summary: Ultimatum no longer spawns in maps at random. You now get it by spending Ultimatum Threads in the Map Device (up to 8, with more Threads raising the chance of random transformative effects) or by running maps in the Ultimatum Shaped Region, which gives free Threads. All Ultimatum scarabs are gone, the Ultimatum atlas cluster was reworked, and map Item Quantity became Atlas Drops, so every 3.29 scarab setup, chance node and quantity rule in this guide is out of date. The encounter itself is mostly the same, but rewards now keep improving past round 10, and the Trialmaster now also drops the Ambition unique Vaal Aspect.

ritual.summary: Ritual no longer rolls on maps at random. You now get it by putting Ritual Threads in the Map Device (up to 8) or by running maps in the Ritual Shaped Region, which gives free Threads. Every Ritual scarab is gone, so all the scarab loadouts, the Stacked Deck setup and the Corpses setup stop working, and the Ritual atlas cluster was reworked with no new values in the notes. Blood-filled Vessels now need Ritual Threads on the map (2 slots at 4+ Threads, 3 at 8). Rerolled Nameless windows give an Omen instead of the Audience/Waxen Soul guarantee, Wisp's Blessing is now 50%, and Opulent altars lose their item quantity bonus.

harvest.summary: Harvest no longer has a Sacred Grove: Sacred Flora of one Lifeforce colour spawn in the map itself, you click one and kill the Sacred Fauna it spawns, and high-tier maps can roll a Sacred Specimen that spawns a Harvest boss. Tier 1 seed monsters stop dropping Lifeforce and Tier 2 drop it less often, but stacks are bigger so the total is meant to be similar. The Fruiting Astrolabe, all scarabs and the Crop Rotation, Refiner's Bargain and Synthesised Stability keystones are gone, Harvest gets no Thread, and its Atlas cluster was reworked, so every 3.29 astrolabe and scarab strategy in the guide is obsolete.

breach.summary: In 3.30 Breach no longer spawns at random in maps. You add it with Breach Threads at the Map Device, or run maps in the Breach Shaped Region, which every Atlas has by default and which gives free Threads. Scarabs, Synthesised Stability and Endless Tide are gone, Enemy at the Gates and Dimensional Foothold are now multiple-choice passives, and the Breach atlas cluster was reworked, so every 3.29 scarab setup and tier rating is out of date. On the Genesis Tree, Lavish Wombgifts now only grow the more valuable currency, Solid Cysts was removed, and the Equipment nodes were lowered.

legion.summary: The Vestigial core stays the same: Generals drop crystals, you Enshroud uniques and charge them in the Domain. What changes is how Legion gets into your maps. It no longer spawns at random, scarabs are gone, and you add it with Legion Threads at the Map Device or by running maps in a Legion Shaped Region, so every scarab setup, Legion-chance node and Astrolabe-modifier line in the guide is out of date. The Legion Atlas cluster was reworked. A sixth crystal, Afarud, Enshrouds unique quivers. Map Item Quantity is now Atlas Drops, which raises Legion splinter drops.

abyss.summary: In 3.30 Abyss no longer spawns at random. You add it by spending Abyss Threads in the Map Device (up to 8, and each extra Thread raises the chance of strong random Abyss effects), or you get free Threads in the Abyss Shaped Region that every Atlas now has. All Abyss Scarabs, Descending included, are gone and the Abyss Atlas cluster was reworked, so the Scarab setups, Depths guarantee and node lists no longer apply. The notes do not change pits, the Depths or Zorath, but Stygian Vises now also drop from the core pool and Merrick's Ducat works directly on Abyssal Jewels.

delirium.summary: 3.30 removes every Delirium Scarab and the Deceptive Astrolabe, and there is no Delirium Thread, so all 3.29 mirror setups lose their Scarabs and the Delirium atlas tree shrinks to mirror-chance clusters. Delirium Orbs now reforge a Rare map with a random 5-50% Delirious mod (same type stacks to 100%, 1 reward plus 1 per 20%), Skittering became Threaded and Fragmented was removed. Mirrors themselves were buffed (faster, longer fog, more orbs, clusters and bosses, bigger splinter stacks, 1-3 bonus rewards) and can be forced with a new Rare-map suffix.

bestiary.summary: Einhar no longer appears at random: you add him with Bestiary Threads (up to 8 per map) or by running maps in the Bestiary Shaped Region. All Scarabs, including the Bestiary Scarabs, were removed. Yellow beasts can no longer be captured, stored ones were deleted, and no recipe needs them now. Flask crafts now take any Red Beast. The Bestiary atlas cluster was reworked, so the 3.29 node names in this guide are unconfirmed.

eldritch.summary: The altars themselves still work the same way, but their rewards changed. Scarabs are gone, so Eater altars now drop Breach, Legion, Blight, Ritual and Incursion Threads, Exarch altars drop Abyss, Expedition, Betrayal, Bestiary and Ultimatum Threads, and the Scarab duplication upside now duplicates Threads. The Item Quantity upside was removed and the Rarity upside dropped to 10-20%. The Atlas tree was also rebuilt, so every 3.29 node, scarab price and "take quantity first" priority in the guide is out of date.

essences.summary: The core loop still works: free and kill imprisoned monsters, and use a Vaal Orb on Screaming MEDS monsters to aim for tier 8. All three Maxroll 3.29 setups are broken, though. Every Essence Scarab is gone and there is no Essence Thread, the Atlas tree and the Essence clusters were reworked, and the Heist, Delve and Bestiary side income from those trees is gone too. Essence generation also changed: Weeping essences no longer appear in yellow or red maps and Wailing no longer appear in red maps, the average number of essences per monster now scales with the map's Atlas Drops, and a new Essence of Trickery was added.

kingsmarch.summary: The way shipping works is unchanged, but ore and bar shipments now return only rarer currency and no quality currency, and rares from shipping and mapping roll lower tiers again. All three ore and map strategies relied on things 3.30 removed: Kalguuran, Sulphite and Cartography Scarabs, the Refiner's Bargain keystone, randomly spawning Sulphite and the 8-mod map corruption. The Ore Deposit atlas clusters were reworked, map deposits give 50% more ore, and Verisium now gives a buff that gets stronger the longer you channel.

vendor.summary: 3.30 changes four recipes the guide lists. A full rare set with any piece below item level 60 now pays Orbs of Alchemy. Two same-name rares now pay a Chaos Orb and three pay an Exalted Orb, with quality ignored. The Vaal Orb recipe needs only 5 Vaal gems, and the four-rarity recipe pays 1 Orb of Chance (was 5). The Chaos/Regal set, 6-socket, 6-link and quality recipes are not mentioned in the notes. Orbs of Chance become rarer and vendors no longer sell them, Strongboxes stop dropping mirrored items, and Scarabs (and the scarab recipe) are gone.

mercenaries.summary: 3.30 removes every Scarab, including all four Trarthan Scarabs, and adds no Mercenary Thread. That ends the Infamy + Renown rush, its Rogue Exile and Delirium variants, and self-found Trarthan Scarab farming. Warrants now open portals to a separate Proving Grounds area instead of being used with a map, and the Mercenary Atlas cluster was reworked inside a fully rebuilt tree, so the 3.29 node names cannot be confirmed. Hired Mercenaries get a resistance penalty that depends on area level, less attack damage and damage reduction at high levels, and more Life. Three uniques are banned or switched off on them, and several Mercenary supports were rebalanced.

atlas.summary: 3.30 removes Scarabs and replaces them with Threads. The ten primary league mechanics now appear only through Threads or Shaped Regions, and the Atlas tree is rebuilt from the centre with 150 points, so almost every 3.29 farm in this guide, its scarab list and its poeplanner tree link is obsolete. Map Item Quantity is now Atlas Drops, item rarity decides currency quality, Vaal Orbs no longer make 8-mod maps, Harvest has no Grove, Delirium Orbs and Embers work differently, and Anomalies need a cleared map.

value.text: To get Jun, spend a Betrayal Thread in the Map Device when you open a map. Threads are a new item type that adds its league mechanic to the area.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Threads can be used when entering an Atlas area through the Map Device to apply the associated League mechanic to that Thread to the area.

value.text: Your Atlas has one Shaped Region of each Thread type by default, Betrayal included. Maps inside the Betrayal region get free Betrayal Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Successfully completing the Shaped Region objective in each Map increases the free Thread count by 1 in all other Maps affected by that Shaped Region.

value.text: You can spend up to 8 Threads on one map. Each extra Thread raises the chance of strong random effects for that mechanic. The notes do not list the effects.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.

value.title: Content Update 3.30.0 — Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra

corrections.reason: Source for the 3.30 changes.

value.text: Blight no longer has a random chance to appear in maps. To get a map Blight, use a Blight Thread or run a map inside a Blight Shaped Region.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following league mechanics no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas: Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.

value.text: Scarabs were removed from the game and Threads replace them. All Blight scarabs (Blight Scarab, Blooming, Blightheart, Invigoration and the rest) are gone.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place.

value.text: You use Threads in the Map Device. You can spend up to 8 on one map, and each extra Thread raises the chance of strong random Blight effects in the area.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: For each Thread expended, up to a maximum of eight, there are also increasingly higher and higher chances to apply powerful randomised transformative effects to the area related to that League mechanic.

value.text: Your Atlas starts with one Shaped Region of each Thread type, Blight included. Maps inside it get free Blight Threads, and finishing the region objective adds 1 more free Thread to the other maps in the region.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Shaped Regions grant affected Maps free Threads of that type.

value.text: In map Blight encounters, the number of chests in each lane now scales with a percentage of the map's Atlas Drops.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The number of Blight chests in each Lane within Blight encounters in your Maps is now scaled by a percentage of Atlas Drops.

value.text: Opening a map unidentified now gives +30% Atlas Drops instead of +30% Item Quantity, which feeds the lane chest count.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Unidentified Maps now grant +30% Atlas Drops when opened (previously +30% Item Quantity).

value.text: Blighted and Blight-Ravaged Maps no longer say on the item that Atlas Drops scales the chests in each lane.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Blighted and Blight Ravaged Maps now longer explicitly specify that Atlas Drops scales the number of Blight chests in each Lane.

value.text: A Silver Oil anoint on a Blighted Map now gives +80% Item Rarity, not +80% Item Quantity. The '3 Silver' Ravaged recipes relied on the old stat.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Blighted Maps Anointed with Silver Oils now have +80% to Item Rarity (previously +80% to Item Quantity).

value.text: The Blight atlas passive cluster was reworked. Fungal Horizons, Epidemiology, Templar Ingenuity, Blightspawn, Immune Response and Sturdy Construction are 3.29 node names, and the notes do not confirm them.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: All Atlas Passive clusters related to Primary League mechanics have been reworked. This includes Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.

value.text: Scarab atlas clusters became Thread clusters, so Fungal Bloom's 'Blight Scarab drops' effect is gone in that form.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: All Scarab related Atlas Passive clusters have been replaced with Thread related clusters.

value.text: The atlas tree was rebuilt. You start in the centre and path outwards, and the maximum is now 150 points (was 138).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The total number of Atlas Passive Skill Points you can earn has been increased to 150 (previously 138).

value.text: Unwavering Vision (reworked): your maps can only take one Thread type, 75% of Threads found turn into Gold, and maps with Threads get 2 extra Threads that can go past the cap of 8.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: It now causes you to be only able to apply one type of Thread to your Maps, and 75% chance for Threads found in your Maps to be converted to Gold.

value.text: Eater of Worlds altars can roll mods that make Eldritch monsters or map bosses drop Blight Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Eater of Worlds Altars now have Modifiers that can cause Eldritch Monsters or Map Bosses to drop Breach, Legion, Blight, Ritual or Incursion Threads.

value.text: Scarabs you already own (in Standard) become a Thread for the same content or a Frayed Thread.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Existing Scarabs will be converted to either a Thread related to that specific Scarab content, or a Frayed Thread.

value.text: Toxic Sewer, the guide's best 3.29 Map Blight map, left the Atlas. So did Orchard, one of the Blighted Map unlock maps.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Lair, Orchard, Pier, Plaza, Primordial Blocks, Shipyard, Stagnation, Toxic Sewer, Vault, and Waterways.

value.text: Dark Forest left the Atlas. With Orchard also gone, the Volcano + Dark Forest + Orchard unlock for Blighted Maps no longer works as written, and the notes do not give a new one.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following Maps have been removed from the Atlas: Alleyways, Arachnid Tomb, Arsenal, Atoll, Bazaar, Beach, Bramble Valley, Cells, Chateau, Courthouse, Dark Forest

value.text: Carcass, Maxroll's 3.28 league-start Blight map, is back on the Atlas.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following Maps have been added back to the Atlas: Academy, Ancient City, Armoury, Barrows, Bone Crypt, Carcass

value.text: Waste Pool, the old runner-up Blight map, is back on the Atlas.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Underground River, Underground Sea, Villa, Waste Pool, and Wasteland.

value.text: Corrupting a non-Unique map can no longer turn it into an 8-mod rare. That outcome now adds 2 explicit mods (up to 9 in total). Keep this in mind when you corrupt Blighted Maps for Tainted Oil.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: This has been replaced with an outcome that will add 2 Explicit Modifiers to a Map (up to a maximum of 9 Modifiers).

value.text: The +10-20% Item Quantity corruption implicit on maps can no longer roll.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Corruption Implicit Modifier on Maps for +10-20% Item Quantity can no longer roll.

value.text: Delirium Orbs no longer enchant maps. They now reforge a rare map with a Delirious mod, so the old 'Delirium-orbed Blight map' setups no longer work the same way.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Delirium Orbs no longer apply enchantments to Maps. Instead they reforge rare Map items with an explicit modifier making players in the area Delirious.

value.text: Blight is one of the league mechanics that lost its fractured-item drops.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Removed many sources of Fractured Items dropping, primarily from League Mechanics such as Legion, Ritual, Heist, Blight, Delirium, Delve and Incursion.

corrections.reason: Source for the 3.30 changes.

value.text: Scarabs are removed, including every Incursion Scarab and the Scarab of Timelines. Threads replace them.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place.

value.text: Incursion no longer has a random chance to appear in maps.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following league mechanics no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas: Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.

value.text: Spend an Incursion Thread at the Map Device to add Incursion to a map.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Threads can be used when entering an Atlas area through the Map Device to apply the associated League mechanic to that Thread to the area.

value.text: Your Atlas starts with a Shaped Region for each Thread type, and maps inside the Incursion one get free Incursion Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Shaped Regions grant affected Maps free Threads of that type.

value.text: Atziri is now the Temple boss. The Vaal Omnitect is gone.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Atziri has taken up residence in the Temple of Atzoatl, evicting the Vaal Omnitect and making some adjustments.

value.text: All nine Vials stop dropping. Vials you already own stay but do nothing.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following Vials no longer drop: Vial of Awakening, Vial of Consequence, Vial of Dominance, Vial of Fate, Vial of the Ghost, Vial of the Ritual, Vial of Sacrifice, Vial of Summoning, Vial of Transcendence.

value.text: The uniques that used to need a Vial now drop inside Temples that contain a Cradle of Creation.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Unique items that required Vials to obtain instead now drop from various places in Temples of Atzoatl that contain a Cradle of Creation.

value.text: The Throne of Atziri is renamed Cradle of Creation. A Temple that contains it is area level 84, and its boss is Uber Atziri.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: While the Temple of Atzoatl contains the Cradle of Creation room, it will be area level 84 and contain Uber Atziri.

value.text: In a Cradle of Creation Temple, every Temple modifier is stronger and all monsters are harder and drop more.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: All Temple Modifiers will have more effect, and all Monsters within the Temple will have more difficulty and reward.

value.text: The Locus Altar of Corruption and the Doryani's Lapidary Lens now corrupt an item or gem a second time. The result is Twice Corrupted and cannot go through either device again.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Altar of Corruption and Lapidary Lens have been changed to instead Corrupt an Equipment Item or Gem a second time.

value.text: The Locus influenced-rare outcome is gone. A roll that would have given it now destroys the item, so the altar destroys items more often.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Altar of Corruption no longer has a chance to change the item into a Corrupted influenced item. Instead, if it would have rolled this outcome, it instead destroys the item.

value.text: The Lapidary Lens in Doryani's Institute can now destroy the gem. The notes give no odds.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Lapidary Lens now has a chance to destroy the item.

value.text: The Apex of Ascension altar no longer transforms uniques found only in the Temple, so Vial upgrades are over.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Altar of Sacrifice in the Apex of Ascension room no longer transforms Unique Items found exclusively in the Temple of Atzoatl.

value.text: Sacrificing a unique at the Apex of Ascension can now return several uniques. A more valuable sacrifice returns more.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Altar of Sacrifice in the Apex of Ascension room can now generate multiple Unique Items, proportional to the value of the Unique Item sacrificed.

value.text: New currency: Royal Visage. Atziri can drop it in Temples of level 81 or higher. Old Mortal Fragments convert into Royal Visages.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Added a new Royal Visage Currency item which can drop from Atziri in level 81+ Temples of Atzoatl.

value.text: A Royal Visage on a Tier 16 map makes that map's Incursions Alluring: monsters are harder and drop more, and Flameblasts and Storm Calls target you.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: A Royal Visage can be used on a Tier 16 Map to add an Enchantment modifier that causes Temporal Incursions in Area to be Alluring.

value.text: Atziri can drop a Soul Core in Temples of level 80 or higher. Four new Soul Cores come from the Temple, and Cradle Temples can drop Intellect, Might or Finesse.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Atziri has a chance to drop a Soul Core in Temples of Atzoatl level 80 or higher.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Rooms within the Temple that add difficulty to the Atziri boss fight add varying amounts of increased chance for Soul Cores to drop from Atziri.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.

value.title: Content Update 3.30.0 — Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra

corrections.reason: Source for the 3.30 changes.

value.title: Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra (official post)

corrections.reason: Source for the 3.30 changes.

value.text: Scarabs are removed from the game. Threads replace them, so every Expedition scarab (Runefinding, Verisium Powder, Archaeology, Infusion and the rest) is gone.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place.

value.text: Expedition no longer appears in maps by random chance. Without an Expedition Thread or a Shaped Region that grants one, a map has no Expedition.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following league mechanics no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas: Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.

value.text: An Expedition Thread is spent at the Map Device to add an Expedition to the map. Up to eight Threads can be spent, each raising the chance of extra Expedition-related effects on the area.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Threads can be used when entering an Atlas area through the Map Device to apply the associated League mechanic to that Thread to the area.

value.text: The Atlas starts with one Shaped Region per Thread type, including Expedition. Maps in it get free Expedition Threads, and completing the region objective in a map adds one free Thread to the region's other maps instead of bonus modifiers.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Shaped Regions grant affected Maps free Threads of that type.

value.text: Searing Exarch altars (not Eater of Worlds) can make Eldritch monsters or map bosses drop Expedition Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Searing Exarch Altars now have Modifiers that can cause Eldritch Monsters or Map Bosses to drop Abyss, Expedition, Betrayal, Bestiary and Ultimatum Threads.

value.text: Astrolabes no longer cover a quadrant. One adds a Shaped Region of its type to a specific map and removes the existing region of that type. Astrolabe regions start with more free Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Astrolabes have been changed to add a Shaped Region of the specified type to a specific Map on the Atlas, removing existing Shaped Regions of that type from the Atlas.

value.text: A map in a Shaped Region cannot be run without its free Thread, and it leaves the region once it is run (official FAQ).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: This is not possible, but that map will be removed from the shaped region after it is run.

value.text: Gwennen no longer gambles items. For one Astragali she offers a 'take a chance' craft on one of your Rare equipment items.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: You can no longer Gamble for items with Gwennen. She instead now offers a new service inviting you to 'take a chance' on one of your Rare equipment items, at the cost of one Astragali.

value.text: Gwennen shows three pairs of crafting options; you pick a pair and a coin flip applies one of its two crafts.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: You can then select one of the 3 sets of options, which will cause Gwennen to flip her coin randomly applying one of the crafting options to your item.

value.text: The Remnant that gave monsters increased Item Quantity is removed.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Removed the Expedition Remnant for increased Item Quantity from Monsters.

value.text: Remnants that made excavated chests and Runic monsters drop Fractured items are disabled.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Disabled Expedition Remnants that cause Excavated chests and Runic monsters to drop Fractured Items.

value.text: Rog's reroll-prefixes and reroll-suffixes deals now reroll 1, 3 or 5 times (was 3, 6 or 10).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Rog now offers deals to Reroll Prefixes and Suffixes 1, 3, or 5 times, keeping the best outcome (previously 3, 6, or 10).

value.text: Rog's deals with more rerolls, and all deals that upgrade modifier tiers, now appear less often.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: In general deals that reroll outcomes more times have lower chances to appear. All deals that upgraded the tiers of Modifiers have lower chances to appear.

value.text: Corrupting a Logbook can no longer reroll it into an 8-modifier rare; that outcome now adds 2 explicit modifiers, up to 9.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: This change also affects Map-like items such as Logbooks, Heist Contracts, Heist Blueprints and Invitations.

value.text: Item Quantity on map modifiers became Atlas Drops at the same values. The notes do not say what Logbook quantity modifiers became.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Replaced Item Quantity on Map Modifiers with Atlas Drops at the same values. This change affects pre-existing items.

value.text: The Expedition Atlas cluster was reworked. The notes do not list the new nodes, so 3.29 node names (Extreme Archaeology, Buried Knowledge, Hunt for Answers and the rest) need checking in game.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: All Atlas Passive clusters related to Primary League mechanics have been reworked.

value.text: Scarab Atlas clusters are now Thread clusters, so small nodes for more scarabs are gone.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: All Scarab related Atlas Passive clusters have been replaced with Thread related clusters.

value.text: The Synthesised Stability keystone is removed (the Astrolabe Dunes strategy relied on it).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following Keystone Atlas Passives have been removed: Crop Rotation, Endless Tide, Lucid Dreams, Meticulous Appraiser, Refiner's Bargain, and Synthesised Stability.

value.text: Unwavering Vision now limits you to one Thread type per map, so Expedition cannot be paired with another Thread mechanic under it.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: It now causes you to be only able to apply one type of Thread to your Maps, and 75% chance for Threads found in your Maps to be converted to Gold.

value.text: Tormented Spirits that spawn naturally near an Expedition now sit in gravestones; detonating one frees the spirit and releases extra spirits.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Tormented Spirits which spawn near Expeditions will now inhabit gravestones, which the player can detonate to free them, releasing additional extra Tormented Spirits.

value.text: Olroth can now drop the Heroic Tragedy Timeless Jewel (moved from the Forgotten Afarud Commander).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: It instead has a chance to drop from Olroth, Origin of the Fall.

value.text: The Eldritch altar modifier that duplicated dropped Scarabs now duplicates Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Eldritch Altar Modifiers that granted a chance for Scarabs dropped by slain Enemies to be Duplicated, instead now apply to Threads.

value.text: Eldritch and Memory Trace altars that granted increased Item Quantity are removed.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Eldritch and Memory Trace Altars that granted increased Quantity of Items found have been removed.

value.text: Scarabs you still hold are converted to a matching Thread or a Frayed Thread.

value.text: From character level 68 Whakano sells Contracts, and rarely Blueprints, for Gold. Their level follows your Atlas completion, and his shop can be rerolled with Gold.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Whakano now sells Contracts and rarely Blueprints for Gold once you are level 68 or higher. The level of Contracts and Blueprints offered is based on your current Atlas completion. In addition you can now reroll Whakano's shop with Gold.

value.text: Whakano's Normal Contracts cost Orbs of Alchemy instead of Orbs of Chance.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Normal Contracts sold by Whakano now cost Orbs of Alchemy instead of Orbs of Chance.

value.text: Reward-room chests in Contracts drop Blueprints much more often.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Greatly increased the chance for Blueprints to drop from Reward room chests in Contracts.

value.text: Finishing a level 68+ Contract can give a bonus Blueprint reveal. Higher-level Contracts have a better chance.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Completing level 68+ Heist Contracts now has a chance to award a bonus Blueprint reveal from Whakano on completion. The chance is higher for higher level Contracts.

value.text: Faustus pays more Markers for Heist Targets, up to double for Targets from level 83 Contracts.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Increased the amount of Rogue Markers that Heist Targets vendor to Faustus for, up to twice as much for Targets from level 83 Contracts.

value.text: Contract and Blueprint modifiers now give more Item Rarity where they used to give Item Quantity. The old advice to always scour Blueprints needs re-testing.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Modifiers on Heist Contracts and Blueprints, Corrupted Side Areas, Incursion Temple Modifiers and Delve Area Modifiers instead grant a higher amount of Item Rarity instead of replacing Item Quantity with Atlas Drops.

value.text: Corrupting a Contract or Blueprint can no longer turn it into an 8-mod rare. That outcome now adds 2 explicit mods, up to 9.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: This change also affects Map-like items such as Logbooks, Heist Contracts, Heist Blueprints and Invitations.

value.text: Heist chests that gave Fragment rewards now give Thread rewards.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Heist Chests that granted Fragment Rewards instead now grant Thread Rewards.

value.text: Rogue gear that could double Fragments now doubles Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Heist Equipment that had a chance to double Fragments instead now doubles Threads.

value.text: Brooches and Thief's Trinkets roll lower 'increased Rarity of Items dropped in Heists'. Old items can get worse if you reroll them with Blessed or Divine Orbs.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Lowered the amount of increased Rarity of Items dropped in Heists on Heist Rogue Brooches and Trinkets. Pre-existing items can be made worse with Blessed/Divine Orbs.

value.text: Brooches and Trinkets can no longer roll increased Quantity of Items dropped in Heists.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Heist Trinket and Brooch Modifiers for increased Quantity of Items dropped in Heists can no longer roll.

value.text: Simplex, Focused and Astrolabe Amulets, Cord Belt, Stygian Vise and six experimented rings can now drop anywhere, on Magic and Rare items of a high enough Item Tier.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following item base types have been added to the core drop pool: Astrolabe Amulet, Cogwork Ring, Composite Ring, Cord Belt, Focused Amulet, Geodesic Ring, Helical Ring, Manifold Ring, Ratcheting Ring, Simplex Amulet, and Stygian Vise.

value.text: Those bases still come from Heist Blueprints, but much less often.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: They still drop from their current sources such as Abyssal Bosses or Heist Blueprints, but with much lower drop chances.

value.text: GGG's 3.30 FAQ says Heist is still the best place to target a Simplex Amulet.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Yes, someone targeting a simplex amulet would be best served farming heist still.

value.text: Scarabs are gone, so Scarab curio rewards are too. Threads replaced them, but Heist has no Thread of its own.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place.

value.text: Heist is one of the mechanics that lost many of its Fractured item drops.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Removed many sources of Fractured Items dropping, primarily from League Mechanics such as Legion, Ritual, Heist, Blight, Delirium, Delve and Incursion.

value.text: Tailoring and Tempering Orbs now have slots in the League section of the Currency Stash Tab.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Refracting Fog, Royal Visage, Soul Core of Finesse, Soul Core of Instability, Soul Core of Intellect, Soul Core of Might, Tailoring Orb, and Tempering Orb.

value.text: Bug fix: escape-route minimap icons in Blueprints now show from a normal distance, not only up close.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Fixed a bug which caused escape route minimap icons in Heist Blueprints not to reveal until you were very close.

corrections.reason: The Heist wheel and random caches are gone, so 'selling Contracts and Blueprints from map caches' is no longer a wheel-boosted side income, and Heist did change in 3.30.
corrections.quote: Smuggler's Caches and Sulphite Deposits no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas.
corrections.match: Heist was not reworked in 3.29. It is cheap to start, Rogues no longer need levelling, and selling Contracts and Blueprints from map caches is a steady side income.
corrections.value: 3.30 removed the Heist Atlas passives and random Smuggler's Caches. Caches now always spawn in several specific Atlas maps, and Markers, Contracts and Blueprints no longer drop as ordinary loot. From level 68 Whakano sells Contracts (rarely Blueprints) for Gold. It is still cheap to start, and Rogues need no levelling.

corrections.reason: Faustus pays more Markers for Targets in 3.30.
corrections.quote: Increased the amount of Rogue Markers that Heist Targets vendor to Faustus for, up to twice as much for Targets from level 83 Contracts.
corrections.match: A Contract is a one-wing Heist. Its target item can only be sold to Faustus, for Rogue's Markers.
corrections.value: A Contract is a one-wing Heist. Its target item can only be sold to Faustus, for Rogue's Markers. 3.30 raised the payout, up to double for Targets from level 83 Contracts.

corrections.reason: Adds the 3.30 bonus reveal from level 68+ Contracts.
corrections.quote: Completing level 68+ Heist Contracts now has a chance to award a bonus Blueprint reveal from Whakano on completion. The chance is higher for higher level Contracts.
corrections.match: Finishing a Contract gives a Blueprint reveal. Area level 68+ always gives one. Below that you get one only within 3 levels of your character.
corrections.value: Finishing a Contract gives a Blueprint reveal. Area level 68+ always gives one. Below that you get one only within 3 levels of your character. Since 3.30 a level 68+ Contract can also give a bonus reveal, more often at higher Contract levels.

corrections.reason: Caches no longer spawn at random, Atlas cache nodes no longer exist, and caches are tied to specific maps.
corrections.quote: Several specific Maps on the Atlas now always spawn Sulphite Veins, or Smuggler's Caches or have a chance to contain a chest with a Forbidden Tome.
corrections.match: Smuggler's Caches in maps always hold Contracts and Markers, with a chance for a Blueprint. Without Atlas nodes they are only occasional.
corrections.value: Smuggler's Caches hold Contracts and Markers, with a chance for a Blueprint (3.30 raised that chance and the number of Markers). Since 3.30 they no longer spawn at random and have no Atlas passives. Several specific Atlas maps always spawn them (the notes do not name the maps), and Blueprints found in those maps can roll special implicits.

corrections.reason: Markers left the core drop pool, so 'monster drops' is wrong.
corrections.quote: Rogue Markers, Contracts and Blueprints are no longer part of the core drop pool.
corrections.match: Rogue's Markers stack to 50,000. They come from caches, monster drops and Faustus.
corrections.value: Rogue's Markers stack to 50,000. Since 3.30 they no longer drop as ordinary monster loot. They come from Smuggler's Caches and from selling Heist Targets to Faustus.

corrections.reason: Mods now give a larger amount of Item Rarity, so 'no better rewards' needs re-testing.
corrections.quote: Modifiers on Heist Contracts and Blueprints, Corrupted Side Areas, Incursion Temple Modifiers and Delve Area Modifiers instead grant a higher amount of Item Rarity instead of replacing Item Quantity with Atlas Drops.
corrections.match: Magic or rare Blueprints are harder with no better rewards, so scour them. Rolling Contracts for difficulty is also not worth it.
corrections.value: Magic or rare Blueprints are harder. Since 3.30 Contract and Blueprint mods give more Item Rarity (in place of Item Quantity), so the old 'always scour' advice is untested this league.

corrections.reason: Fragment reward chests no longer exist in Heist, so the old Fragment-room warning is obsolete.
corrections.quote: Heist Chests that granted Fragment Rewards instead now grant Thread Rewards.
corrections.match: In 3.28, revealed Fragment side rooms could turn into Delve rooms. 3.29.0 fixed Delve chests appearing in Contracts and Blueprints.
corrections.value: Since 3.30, Heist chests that gave Fragment rewards give Thread rewards instead, and Rogue gear that doubled Fragments doubles Threads.

corrections.reason: The Casing the Joint passive no longer exists.
corrections.quote: Atlas Passive clusters related to Delve and Heist have been removed.
corrections.match: Fully revealed Blueprints from Casing the Joint sell well.
corrections.value: Fully revealed Blueprints sell well, but Casing the Joint, which dropped them, was removed in 3.30.

corrections.reason: These bases are now in the core drop pool and are rarer from Blueprints, which changes supply and value.
corrections.quote: They still drop from their current sources such as Abyssal Bosses or Heist Blueprints, but with much lower drop chances.
corrections.match: Experimented bases worth taking include Simplex, Focused and Astrolabe Amulets and Helical and Manifold Rings. Their value depends on item level.
corrections.value: Experimented bases worth taking include Simplex, Focused and Astrolabe Amulets and Helical and Manifold Rings. Their value depends on item level. Since 3.30 they also drop outside Heist, on Magic and Rare items of a high enough Item Tier, and much less often from Heist Blueprints. GGG's 3.30 FAQ still calls Heist the best place to target a Simplex Amulet.

corrections.reason: Blueprint mods now give more Item Rarity, so 'not rewards' is wrong.
corrections.quote: Modifiers on Heist Contracts and Blueprints, Corrupted Side Areas, Incursion Temple Modifiers and Delve Area Modifiers instead grant a higher amount of Item Rarity instead of replacing Item Quantity with Atlas Drops.
corrections.match: Scour any magic or rare Blueprint. Mods add difficulty, not rewards.
corrections.value: Magic or rare Blueprint mods add difficulty. Since 3.30 they also add Item Rarity, so scouring is no longer clearly right.

corrections.reason: There is no Heist wheel any more. This strategy's atlasPassives list (The Dutiful Soldier, Secret Stash, Casing the Joint, No Honour Among Thieves) names only removed nodes and should be emptied. Those names also appear elsewhere in the guide, so no separate unique match can be given for them.
corrections.quote: Atlas Passive clusters related to Delve and Heist have been removed.
corrections.match: Heist wheel inside a Mercenary + Delirium mapping setup
corrections.value: No Atlas points (the Heist clusters were removed in 3.30). Run the maps that always spawn Smuggler's Caches

corrections.reason: The Dutiful Soldier is gone, and its effect is now built into Blueprints from the cache maps.
corrections.quote: Blueprints found in these Maps inherently have a chance to have special Implicit Modifiers.
corrections.match: Take The Dutiful Soldier. In 3.29 it gives map Blueprints a 15% chance to roll a special implicit.
corrections.value: Since 3.30, Blueprints found in the maps that always spawn Smuggler's Caches have a built-in chance to roll a special implicit. No Atlas passive is needed, and the notes give no percentage.

corrections.reason: Scarabs no longer exist, and the notes do not give the category's new name.
corrections.quote: Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place.
corrections.match: The implicit forces a curio category: Currency or Scarabs, Experimented Items, Replica Uniques, Enchanted Armaments, or Thieves' Trinkets.
corrections.value: The implicit forces a curio category: Currency, Experimented Items, Replica Uniques, Enchanted Armaments, or Thieves' Trinkets. (In 3.29 the first was 'Currency or Scarabs'. Scarabs were removed in 3.30, so check the in-game wording.)

corrections.reason: Scarab targets no longer exist.
corrections.quote: Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place.
corrections.match: Rough: Currency or Scarab forced-target Blueprints give a steadier return. Experimented ones are jackpot-driven and need far bigger samples.
corrections.value: Rough (3.29): Currency forced-target Blueprints (then 'Currency or Scarabs') gave a steadier return. Experimented ones are jackpot-driven and need far bigger samples. Scarabs were removed in 3.30.

corrections.reason: Contract and Blueprint mods now give more Item Rarity, so the blanket scour advice needs re-testing.
corrections.quote: Modifiers on Heist Contracts and Blueprints, Corrupted Side Areas, Incursion Temple Modifiers and Delve Area Modifiers instead grant a higher amount of Item Rarity instead of replacing Item Quantity with Atlas Drops.
corrections.match: Scour magic/rare Blueprints before running
corrections.value: Blueprint mods add Rarity since 3.30: scouring is untested

corrections.reason: Delete the whole table. Every node in it was removed with the Heist Atlas cluster.
corrections.quote: Atlas Passive clusters related to Delve and Heist have been removed.
corrections.match: Heist Atlas wheel (current)

corrections.reason: Retire the whole strategy: its investment, its first and last steps and all nine atlasPassives entries depend on the Heist Atlas wheel and random caches, and 3.30 removed both. Cache maps are covered in the howTo cache line.
corrections.quote: Atlas Passive clusters related to Delve and Heist have been removed.
corrections.match: Cache farming in maps (U4N / GAMES.GG)

corrections.reason: The session depended on random map caches from the Heist wheel inside a mapping tree. 3.30 removed both, so the figure cannot be repeated.
corrections.quote: Smuggler's Caches and Sulphite Deposits no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas.
corrections.match: Rough, unverified: 176 div in 4h20m (about 40 div/h, 35 div/h as a conservative figure). This is one session that mixed Mercenary, Delirium and Heist caches, so it is not a Heist-only number.

corrections.reason: No Honour Among Thieves was removed with the Heist Atlas cluster.
corrections.quote: Atlas Passive clusters related to Delve and Heist have been removed.
corrections.match: Sources disagree on No Honour Among Thieves. GAMES.GG says most maps get 2 caches. U4N and PoEDB say it is a 15% chance for 6 extra caches.

corrections.reason: Casing the Joint was removed with the Heist Atlas cluster.
corrections.quote: Atlas Passive clusters related to Delve and Heist have been removed.
corrections.match: Casing the Joint only doubles a cache's base Blueprint chance. Not every cache will hold a Blueprint.

value.title: Content Update 3.30.0 — Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra

corrections.reason: Source for the 3.30 changes.

value.text: Ultimatum no longer has a random chance to spawn in maps. You only get it from Ultimatum Threads or the Ultimatum Shaped Region.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following league mechanics no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas: Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.

value.text: Scarabs were removed, including Bribing, Dueling, Catalysing, Inscription and Domination. Threads replace them, and there is an Ultimatum Thread.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place.

value.text: You spend Threads in the Map Device to add Ultimatum to a map. You can spend up to 8, and each extra Thread raises the chance of random transformative Ultimatum effects.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: For each Thread expended, up to a maximum of eight, there are also increasingly higher and higher chances to apply powerful randomised transformative effects to the area related to that League mechanic.

value.text: Your Atlas starts with an Ultimatum Shaped Region, one of 10 Shaped Region types.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: There are 10 types of Shaped Region, each associated with a specific type of Thread. By default your Atlas has a Shaped Region of each Thread type on it.

value.text: Maps in the Ultimatum Shaped Region get free Ultimatum Threads. Each map where you complete the region objective adds 1 free Thread to the other maps in the region.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Successfully completing the Shaped Region objective in each Map increases the free Thread count by 1 in all other Maps affected by that Shaped Region.

value.text: Completing Shaped Region objectives no longer gives the other maps in the region bonus modifiers.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Completing Shaped Region objectives no longer grants other Maps in that Shaped Region bonus modifiers.

value.text: An Astrolabe now puts its Shaped Region on one map you choose and removes the existing region of that type. Astrolabe regions start with more free Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Astrolabes have been changed to add a Shaped Region of the specified type to a specific Map on the Atlas, removing existing Shaped Regions of that type from the Atlas.

value.text: Searing Exarch altars can now roll modifiers that make Eldritch monsters or map bosses drop Ultimatum Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Searing Exarch Altars now have Modifiers that can cause Eldritch Monsters or Map Bosses to drop Abyss, Expedition, Betrayal, Bestiary and Ultimatum Threads.

value.text: Leftover Ultimatum scarabs are converted to Ultimatum Threads or Frayed Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Existing Scarabs will be converted to either a Thread related to that specific Scarab content, or a Frayed Thread.

value.text: New currency: a Frayed Thread can be used or vendored for a random Thread.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Added a new Currency Item, Frayed Thread which can be used to grant a random Thread, or vendored for a random Thread.

value.text: The Trialmaster now drops the Ambition unique Vaal Aspect.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Ambition Unique Vaal Aspect now drops from the Trialmaster.

value.text: Unique Vaal Aspects, including Ambition, drop unidentified from bosses.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Unique Vaal Aspects now drop Unidentified from Bosses.

value.text: The Ultimatum atlas cluster was reworked. The notes do not list the new nodes, so every 3.29 node named in this guide needs checking in game.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: All Atlas Passive clusters related to Primary League mechanics have been reworked. This includes Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.

value.text: Atlas nodes that made dropped scarabs more likely to be Ultimatum Scarabs are gone. Scarab clusters became Thread clusters.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: All Scarab related Atlas Passive clusters have been replaced with Thread related clusters.

value.text: Some old scarab effects moved onto the new core Atlas tree. The notes do not say which Ultimatum scarab effects moved.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Many effects that previously existed on Scarabs have been partially or fully absorbed by the new Core Atlas Passive Tree.

value.text: The whole Atlas passive tree was rebuilt and now starts at the centre.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Atlas Passive Tree has been completely reworked. You now begin at the centre of the tree, and head outwards.

value.text: Gruelling Gauntlet and Ruinous Wager are not on the list of removed keystones, but the notes do not confirm what they do in 3.30.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following Keystone Atlas Passives have been removed: Crop Rotation, Endless Tide, Lucid Dreams, Meticulous Appraiser, Refiner's Bargain, and Synthesised Stability.

value.text: For Ultimatum-only farming, Unwavering Vision limits maps to one Thread type and adds 2 extra Threads, which can go past the cap of 8. It also turns 75% of the Threads you find into Gold.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Your Maps with Threads applied also gain 2 additional Threads, which can bypass the 8 Thread maximum.

value.text: Map modifiers now give Atlas Drops instead of Item Quantity, at the same values. This also changes existing maps.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Replaced Item Quantity on Map Modifiers with Atlas Drops at the same values. This change affects pre-existing items.

value.text: Each 1% of Atlas Drops gives 1% more Maps and Threads found.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Each percentage of increased Atlas Drops increases the quantity of Maps and Threads found in the area by 1%.

value.text: Atlas Drops also raises league-specific resources. The notes give Hiveblood and Lifeforce as examples and do not name Catalysts.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: It also affects the quantity of League-specific resources found, such as Hiveblood from Breach monsters or Lifeforce from Harvest monsters.

value.text: Dextral and Sinistral Catalysts can now be traded on the Currency Exchange, and the Ultimatum Stash Tab now has slots for them.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following items have been added to the Currency Exchange: The Black Barya, Dextral Catalyst, Essence of Desolation, Refracting Fog, and Sinistral Catalyst.

value.text: Mirages now appear in maps. The notes do not restate where Dextral and Sinistral Catalysts drop.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Mirages can now be found in Map Areas.

corrections.reason: Ultimatum is now opt-in through Threads or a Shaped Region.
corrections.quote: The following league mechanics no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas: Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.
corrections.match: Ultimatum is a 10-round map encounter.
corrections.value: Ultimatum is a 10-round map encounter. Since 3.30 it no longer spawns at random. You get it by spending Ultimatum Threads in the Map Device or by running maps in the Ultimatum Shaped Region.

corrections.reason: The random spawn chance no longer exists.
corrections.quote: The following league mechanics no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas: Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.
corrections.match: With no atlas or scarab investment, about 8% of maps have an encounter (3.23 baseline).
corrections.value: Ultimatum no longer spawns in maps at random. Spend at least one Ultimatum Thread in the Map Device, or run maps in the Ultimatum Shaped Region, which get free Ultimatum Threads.

corrections.reason: Encounter chance no longer exists, and the Ultimatum cluster was reworked.
corrections.quote: All Atlas Passive clusters related to Primary League mechanics have been reworked. This includes Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.
corrections.match: To see more encounters, take the Ultimatum Chance small nodes (6 nodes, +12% each) and Face The Ultimatum (+30%).
corrections.value: The 3.29 encounter-chance nodes (the Ultimatum Chance small nodes and Face The Ultimatum) have no spawn chance left to raise. The Ultimatum atlas cluster was reworked in 3.30, so check the new nodes in game.

corrections.reason: There is no random spawn left to block, and the cluster was reworked.

value.title: Content Update 3.30.0 — Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra

corrections.reason: Source for the 3.30 changes.

value.text: Ritual no longer has a random chance to appear in maps. To get it, use Ritual Threads in the Map Device or run a map in the Ritual Shaped Region.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following league mechanics no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas: Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.

value.text: Scarabs were removed, including every Ritual scarab (Selectiveness, Abundance, Corpses, Wisps) and the Divination Scarab of the Cloister. Threads replace them, and one of them is the Ritual Thread.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place.

value.text: Threads are spent in the Map Device to add their mechanic to the map. You can spend up to 8, and each extra Thread raises the chance of random transformative effects for that mechanic.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: For each Thread expended, up to a maximum of eight, there are also increasingly higher and higher chances to apply powerful randomised transformative effects to the area related to that League mechanic.

value.text: Maps in a Shaped Region get free Threads of that type. Completing the region objective in a map adds 1 free Thread to every other map in the region.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Successfully completing the Shaped Region objective in each Map increases the free Thread count by 1 in all other Maps affected by that Shaped Region.

value.text: Blood-filled Vessels can only go into maps that already have Ritual Threads. A Vessel no longer starts a Ritual on its own.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Blood-Filled Vessels can only be added to Maps that have Ritual Threads applied.

value.text: Vessel slots now depend on how many Ritual Threads you use: 2 slots at 4 or more Threads, 3 slots at 8. The old flat limit of 4 is gone.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: 2 Blood-Filled Vessel slots are available for 4 or more Ritual Threads, and 3 Blood-Filled Vessel slots are available for 8 Ritual Threads.

value.text: At a Nameless altar, only the first reward window still guarantees An Audience with the King or a Waxen Soul. Rerolled windows no longer do.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Rerolls of offered rewards beyond the initial window of offered rewards at a Nameless Ritual altar will no longer always guarantee an Audience with the King or Waxen Soul.

value.text: Every rerolled Nameless window now has at least one Omen.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: They will instead always generate at least one Omen.

value.text: The King in the Mists now always drops a Ritual base at item level 85 or 86.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The King in the Mists now always drops an item level 85 or 86 Ritual base type.

value.text: Wisp's Blessing now gives 50% increased Tribute (was 30%).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Wisp's Blessing Buff now grants 50% increased Tribute gained (previously 30%).

value.text: The Wisp that gives Wisp's Blessing teleports far less often, so the buff is easier to keep.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Wisp which applies Wisp's Blessing in Ritual Encounters now teleports far less frequently.

value.text: The Ritual atlas cluster was reworked. The notes give no new node names or values, so every 3.29 Ritual node (Occult Devotion, Profitable Prayers, Flexible Dogma, Immutable Dogma, Arbitrary Tenets, Answered Appeals, Sacrificial Due) needs checking in game.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: All Atlas Passive clusters related to Primary League mechanics have been reworked. This includes Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.

value.text: The Atlas tree was rebuilt and now starts at the centre, so the 3.29 'points from start' path lengths no longer apply.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Atlas Passive Tree has been completely reworked. You now begin at the centre of the tree, and head outwards.

value.text: Opulent Ritual monsters no longer get increased Item Quantity. Item Rarity was raised to make up for it.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Opulent Rituals no longer grant Ritual Monsters increased Item Quantity.

value.text: Many sources of Fractured items were removed, and Ritual is one of the mechanics named.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Removed many sources of Fractured Items dropping, primarily from League Mechanics such as Legion, Ritual, Heist, Blight, Delirium, Delve and Incursion.

value.text: Veiled items are no longer rewards outside Betrayal, so they no longer appear among Ritual Favours.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Veiled Items have been removed as reward outcomes from non-Betrayal content.

value.text: Eater of Worlds altars can now roll mods that make Eldritch monsters or map bosses drop Ritual Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Eater of Worlds Altars now have Modifiers that can cause Eldritch Monsters or Map Bosses to drop Breach, Legion, Blight, Ritual or Incursion Threads.

value.text: Leftover Ritual scarabs turn into Ritual Threads or Frayed Threads. A Frayed Thread can be used or sold to a vendor for a random Thread.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Existing Scarabs will be converted to either a Thread related to that specific Scarab content, or a Frayed Thread.

value.text: Map mods no longer give Item Quantity. They give Atlas Drops at the same values, and Atlas Drops also raises the number of Maps and Threads found.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Replaced Item Quantity on Map Modifiers with Atlas Drops at the same values. This change affects pre-existing items.

value.text: Reworked Unwavering Vision keystone: maps can use only one Thread type and each Thread found has a 75% chance to become Gold, but Thread maps get 2 extra Threads that can go past the cap of 8. This matters if you farm only Ritual.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Your Maps with Threads applied also gain 2 additional Threads, which can bypass the 8 Thread maximum.

value.text: Blood Shrine of Crows gives much more Chaos Resistance.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Blood Shrine of Crows now grants significantly higher Chaos Resistance.

value.text: You can remove a Blood Shrine buff by right-clicking its icon.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Blood Shrines can now be removed by right-clicking the Buff icon.

value.text: Blood Shrine buffs now stay with you when you move between combat areas.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Blood Shrine buffs will now be retained when transitioning between combat areas.
