value.title: Content Update 3.30.0 — Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra

corrections.reason: Source for the 3.30 changes.

value.title: Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra (official post)

corrections.reason: Source for the 3.30 changes.

value.text: Breach no longer has a random chance to spawn in maps. You have to add it yourself.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following league mechanics no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas: Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.

value.text: Scarabs were removed from the game, and Threads replace them. Breach Scarabs, Scarab of Wisps, Monstrous Lineage, Horned Scarab of Bloodlines and the rest are gone.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place.

value.text: A Breach Thread, used when you open a map through the Map Device, adds Breach to that map.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Threads can be used when entering an Atlas area through the Map Device to apply the associated League mechanic to that Thread to the area.

value.text: Up to 8 Threads count. Each extra Thread raises the chance of random transformative Breach effects in the map.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: For each Thread expended, up to a maximum of eight, there are also increasingly higher and higher chances to apply powerful randomised transformative effects to the area related to that League mechanic.

value.text: Every Atlas starts with one Shaped Region per Thread type, so there is a Breach Shaped Region by default.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: There are 10 types of Shaped Region, each associated with a specific type of Thread. By default your Atlas has a Shaped Region of each Thread type on it.

value.text: Maps in the Breach Shaped Region get free Breach Threads. Each completed region objective adds 1 free Thread to the other maps in the region.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Successfully completing the Shaped Region objective in each Map increases the free Thread count by 1 in all other Maps affected by that Shaped Region.

value.text: Completing maps in a Shaped Region no longer adds bonus modifiers to the other maps. The region no longer gets harder and richer that way.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Completing Shaped Region objectives no longer grants other Maps in that Shaped Region bonus modifiers.

value.text: An Astrolabe (such as the Grasping Astrolabe) now places its Shaped Region on a specific map and removes the existing region of that type.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Astrolabes have been changed to add a Shaped Region of the specified type to a specific Map on the Atlas, removing existing Shaped Regions of that type from the Atlas.

value.text: A region placed by an Astrolabe starts with more free Threads than the default region.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Shaped Regions applied by Astrolabes have a higher base number of free Threads applied to Maps in the Region.

value.text: Official FAQ: a map in a Shaped Region always carries the free Threads, but it leaves the region once you have run it.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: This is not possible, but that map will be removed from the shaped region after it is run.

value.text: Enemy at the Gates and Dimensional Foothold are no longer keystones. Both are now multiple-choice passives.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Dimensional Foothold and Enemy at the Gates Keystone Passive Skills have been converted to multiple-choice Passives.

value.text: Synthesised Stability and Endless Tide were removed. The 3.29 Unstable Breach farm relied on Synthesised Stability.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following Keystone Atlas Passives have been removed: Crop Rotation, Endless Tide, Lucid Dreams, Meticulous Appraiser, Refiner's Bargain, and Synthesised Stability.

value.text: The Atlas tree was rebuilt from the centre and now has 150 points (was 138).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The total number of Atlas Passive Skill Points you can earn has been increased to 150 (previously 138).

value.text: Unwavering Vision now limits you to one Thread type and turns 75% of found Threads into Gold, but adds 2 Threads that can exceed the cap of 8.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Your Maps with Threads applied also gain 2 additional Threads, which can bypass the 8 Thread maximum.

value.text: Lavish Wombgifts now only grow the more valuable currency items, and several Genesis Tree nodes that give extra currency were lowered.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Lavish Wombgifts now only birth more valuable Currency items. As a result several nodes that grant additional Currency items have had their values lowered.

value.text: Solid Cysts (fractured mod) was removed from the Genesis Equipment subtree.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Removed the Solid Cysts Notable Passive from the Genesis Tree Equipment subtree.

value.text: Genesis Equipment modifier-type notables now give 200% increased chance (was 300%) or 50% reduced chance (was 60%).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Notables now grant Birthed Equipment has 200% increased chance for a specific type of Modifier (previously 300)

value.text: Genesis Equipment small nodes now give +10 Modifier Tier Rating (was +20).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: On the Genesis Equipment Tree, small nodes now grant Birthed Equipment has +10 to Modifier Tier Rating (previously +20).

value.text: Item Quantity on maps is now Atlas Drops, and Atlas Drops also raises the amount of Hiveblood from Breach monsters.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: It also affects the quantity of League-specific resources found, such as Hiveblood from Breach monsters or Lifeforce from Harvest monsters.

value.text: Eater of Worlds altars can roll modifiers that make Eldritch monsters or map bosses drop Breach Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Eater of Worlds Altars now have Modifiers that can cause Eldritch Monsters or Map Bosses to drop Breach, Legion, Blight, Ritual or Incursion Threads.

value.text: Eldritch altar scarab-duplication modifiers now duplicate Threads instead.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Eldritch Altar Modifiers that granted a chance for Scarabs dropped by slain Enemies to be Duplicated, instead now apply to Threads.

value.text: Memory Altar modifiers that added Breach were disabled.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Memory Altar modifiers that enabled Primary League Mechanics such as Abyss, Breach or Legion have been disabled.

value.text: The Breach Containment Chamber and House of the Others temple rooms now also add pack size to Breaches.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Breach Containment Chamber and House of the Others now also grants additional Pack Size to Breaches.

value.text: Delirium Orbs no longer add enchantment layers. Each orb reforges a rare map with a Delirious modifier, which affects the Unstable Breach farm's map setup.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Delirium Orbs no longer apply enchantments to Maps. Instead they reforge rare Map items with an explicit modifier making players in the area Delirious.

corrections.reason: The guide is being updated for 3.30. Sections that still hold 3.29 data are labelled as such by the fixes below.
corrections.quote: All Atlas Passive clusters related to Primary League mechanics have been reworked. This includes Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.
corrections.match: Breach (3.29)
corrections.value: Breach (3.30)

corrections.reason: Breach no longer spawns at random in maps, and the S tier rating was for a 3.29 setup built on scarabs and Synthesised Stability, which 3.30 removed.
corrections.quote: The following league mechanics no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas: Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.
corrections.match: Breach has been core since 3.28. From the Act 6 Mud Flats, areas can spawn Breach Hives or Unstable Breaches. They pay out Hiveblood and Wombgifts, which you grow into currency, uniques and rares at the Genesis Tree or sell to other players. 3.29 nerfed Unstable Breaches (2 open at most, fewer monsters), but Maxroll still ranks the Unstable Breach farm S tier as the best raw currency farm. A cheap league-start version farms Hiveblood and Wombgifts instead.
corrections.value: Breach has been core since 3.28. In 3.30 it no longer spawns at random in maps: you add it with Breach Threads at the Map Device, or run maps in the Breach Shaped Region, which gives free Threads. Hives and Unstable Breaches pay out Hiveblood and Wombgifts, which you grow into currency, uniques and rares at the Genesis Tree or sell to other players. Only 2 Unstable Breaches can be open at once since 3.29. Scarabs were removed and the Breach atlas cluster was reworked in 3.30, so the 3.29 scarab setups and tier ratings below are out of date.

corrections.reason: The notes remove the random spawn in Map areas only. Campaign spawning is unchanged.
corrections.quote: The following league mechanics no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas: Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.
corrections.match: From the Act 6 Mud Flats, areas can spawn a Breach Hive or Unstable Breaches. An area never has both, and never more than one Hive.
corrections.value: In the campaign, areas from the Act 6 Mud Flats can spawn a Breach Hive or Unstable Breaches. An area never has both, and never more than one Hive. In maps Breach no longer spawns at random: apply Breach Threads at the Map Device or run a map in the Breach Shaped Region.

corrections.reason: Both keystones became multiple-choice passives.
corrections.quote: The Dimensional Foothold and Enemy at the Gates Keystone Passive Skills have been converted to multiple-choice Passives.
corrections.match: Pick one atlas keystone: Enemy at the Gates makes every Breach an Unstable Breach, and Dimensional Foothold makes every Breach a Hive.
corrections.value: Enemy at the Gates (every Breach is an Unstable Breach) and Dimensional Foothold (every Breach is a Hive) are no longer keystones. In 3.30 they are multiple-choice passives on the reworked Atlas tree.

corrections.reason: Lavish results were narrowed to the more valuable currency.
corrections.quote: Lavish Wombgifts now only birth more valuable Currency items. As a result several nodes that grant additional Currency items have had their values lowered.
corrections.match: What each Wombgift grows: Provisioning gives armour or jewellery, Lavish gives currency, Ancient gives a unique, and Mysterious gives a random item.
corrections.value: What each Wombgift grows: Provisioning gives armour or jewellery, Lavish gives currency (since 3.30 only the more valuable currency items), Ancient gives a unique, and Mysterious gives a random item.

corrections.reason: Regions no longer stack bonus modifiers. They add free Threads.
corrections.quote: Completing Shaped Region objectives no longer grants other Maps in that Shaped Region bonus modifiers.
corrections.match: The Grasping Astrolabe region gets harder with every map you complete.
corrections.value: Breach Shaped Region maps no longer gain bonus modifiers as you complete the region. Each completed objective adds 1 free Breach Thread to the other maps instead.

corrections.reason: Breach is opt-in through Threads or a Shaped Region, so blocking it on the Atlas is no longer needed. Breach Scarabs were removed and the Breach cluster was reworked.
corrections.quote: All primary league mechanics - that is, mechanics with Threads associated - will not appear unless you spend a thread
corrections.match: Never take Dimensional Barrier on a Breach tree. It turns Breaches and Breach Scarab drops off.
corrections.value: Dimensional Barrier turned Breach off on the 3.29 tree. In 3.30 Breach only appears in maps when you spend a Breach Thread or run the Breach Shaped Region, and Breach Scarabs no longer exist.

corrections.reason: The 3.29 price was set before the change to what Lavish Wombgifts grow.
corrections.quote: Lavish Wombgifts now only birth more valuable Currency items.
corrections.match: Lavish Wombgift price depends on item level: ilvl 84 about 40c (0.1 div), ilvl 75 about 5.5c (2026-11-04).
corrections.value: Lavish Wombgift price depends on item level: in 3.29 ilvl 84 was about 40c (0.1 div) and ilvl 75 about 5.5c (2026-11-04). Since 3.30 Lavish Wombgifts only grow the more valuable currency items, so re-check prices.

corrections.reason: The scarab was removed. Breach Threads are what add Breach to a map now.
corrections.quote: Threads can be used when entering an Atlas area through the Map Device to apply the associated League mechanic to that Thread to the area.
corrections.match: Stack Breach Scarab of Instability.
corrections.value: Apply Breach Threads at the Map Device. Up to 8 count, and more Threads raise the chance of extra transformative Breach effects.

corrections.reason: Scarab clusters were replaced with Thread clusters, and Synthesised Stability no longer exists.
corrections.quote: All Scarab related Atlas Passive clusters have been replaced with Thread related clusters.
corrections.match: Scarab nodes; no Synthesised Stability, no Beyond
corrections.value: Thread nodes (the Scarab clusters became Thread clusters in 3.30); no Beyond

corrections.reason: A Breach Shaped Region exists by default, and Astrolabe regions now target a specific map and give more free Threads.
corrections.quote: Shaped Regions applied by Astrolabes have a higher base number of free Threads applied to Maps in the Region.
corrections.match: Place a Grasping Astrolabe to make a Shaped Region of Breach maps.
corrections.value: Run maps in the Breach Shaped Region for free Breach Threads. A Grasping Astrolabe now places the region on a specific map and starts it with more free Threads.

corrections.reason: The item quantity altars were removed, and the scarab-duplication altar modifiers now duplicate Threads.
corrections.quote: The Eldritch and Memory Trace Altars that granted increased Quantity of Items found have been removed.
corrections.match: Pick currency duplication, item quantity and scarab duplication altars.
corrections.value: Pick currency duplication and Thread duplication altars. The item quantity altars were removed in 3.30.

corrections.reason: Endless Tide was removed, and Beyond now only has clusters that raise its spawn chance.
corrections.quote: Tertiary League mechanics, such as Beyond, Buried Sentinels, Delirium Mirrors, Mirage, and the Viridian Wildwood now only have Atlas Passive clusters that increase the chance for that mechanic to randomly appear in Maps.
corrections.match: Beyond: Endless Tide, Scent of Blood, Pale Clarion, 11 Beyond Chance nodes
corrections.value: Beyond: spawn-chance nodes only in 3.30 (Endless Tide was removed)

corrections.reason: The Atlas tree now has 150 points.

corrections.reason: All the listed scarabs were removed. Breach Threads are what add Breach now.
corrections.quote: Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place.
corrections.match: Budget: Scarab of Wisps, Breach Scarab of Instability x2, Scarab of Monstrous Lineage x2
corrections.value: Breach Threads (up to 8 per map)

corrections.reason: It refers to a scarab that no longer exists.

corrections.reason: The scarab that forced a Fortress no longer exists. The notes only say that scarab effects were partly or fully absorbed into the tree, without naming which.

value.title: Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra (official post)

corrections.reason: Source for the 3.30 changes.

value.text: Legion no longer has a random chance to spawn in maps.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following league mechanics no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas: Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.

value.text: All scarabs were removed, including every Legion Scarab. Threads replace them.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place.

value.text: A Legion Thread spent at the Map Device adds Legion to the map.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Threads can be used when entering an Atlas area through the Map Device to apply the associated League mechanic to that Thread to the area.

value.text: Up to 8 Threads count per map. Each one raises the chance of random transformative effects for that mechanic.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: For each Thread expended, up to a maximum of eight, there are also increasingly higher and higher chances to apply powerful randomised transformative effects to the area related to that League mechanic.

value.text: Official FAQ: Legion only appears if you spend a Thread, so you no longer need to block it on the Atlas.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: All primary league mechanics - that is, mechanics with Threads associated - will not appear unless you spend a thread

value.text: By default the Atlas has a Legion Shaped Region, and maps inside it get free Legion Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: There are 10 types of Shaped Region, each associated with a specific type of Thread. By default your Atlas has a Shaped Region of each Thread type on it.

value.text: Each completed objective in a Shaped Region adds 1 free Thread to the other maps in that region.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Successfully completing the Shaped Region objective in each Map increases the free Thread count by 1 in all other Maps affected by that Shaped Region.

value.text: Shaped Regions no longer give bonus modifiers, so the old Timeless Astrolabe mod list is gone.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Completing Shaped Region objectives no longer grants other Maps in that Shaped Region bonus modifiers.

value.text: An Astrolabe now puts a Shaped Region of its type on a specific map and removes the existing region of that type.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Astrolabes have been changed to add a Shaped Region of the specified type to a specific Map on the Atlas, removing existing Shaped Regions of that type from the Atlas.

value.text: A region placed by an Astrolabe starts with more free Threads than a default region.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Shaped Regions applied by Astrolabes have a higher base number of free Threads applied to Maps in the Region.

value.text: New sixth crystal: the Afarud Enshrouding Crystal Enshrouds unique quivers. It drops from the Afarud General in Miraged Legion encounters.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Added an Afarud Enshrouding Crystal that can Enshroud Unique Quivers. It can drop from the Afarud General in Miraged Legion encounters.

value.text: Bug fix: Aukuna and Hyrri gave twice as much charge progress in the Domain as the other Generals. They now give the same as the rest.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Fixed a bug where Aukuna and Hyrri were granting twice as much progress to Enshrouded items in the Domain of Timeless Conflict compared to the other Legion Generals.

value.text: Breaking out Legion monsters and chests builds about 33% less progress towards a Schism.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Reduced the amount that breaking out Legion monsters and chests progressively causes up a Schism by approximately 33%.

value.text: Map Item Quantity is now Atlas Drops, which raises the chance of Splinters from Legion monsters.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Additionally it increases the chance for additional drops from specific monsters within Maps, such as the chance to drop a Conqueror's Exalted Orb from a Conqueror Boss or Splinters from Legion monsters.

value.text: The Legion Atlas cluster was reworked. The notes give no node names or values, so check the 3.29 node list in game.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: All Atlas Passive clusters related to Primary League mechanics have been reworked. This includes Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.

value.text: Many old scarab effects moved, in part or in full, onto the new Atlas tree. The notes do not say which ones.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Many effects that previously existed on Scarabs have been partially or fully absorbed by the new Core Atlas Passive Tree.

value.text: Unwavering Vision limits maps to one Thread type and turns 75% of the Threads found into Gold.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: It now causes you to be only able to apply one type of Thread to your Maps, and 75% chance for Threads found in your Maps to be converted to Gold.

value.text: With Unwavering Vision, maps with Threads also get 2 extra Threads that can go past the 8-Thread cap.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Your Maps with Threads applied also gain 2 additional Threads, which can bypass the 8 Thread maximum.

value.text: Eater of Worlds altars can make Eldritch monsters or map bosses drop Legion Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Eater of Worlds Altars now have Modifiers that can cause Eldritch Monsters or Map Bosses to drop Breach, Legion, Blight, Ritual or Incursion Threads.

value.text: Memory Altar modifiers that added Legion were disabled.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Memory Altar modifiers that enabled Primary League Mechanics such as Abyss, Breach or Legion have been disabled.

value.text: Most places that used to drop scarabs now drop Threads. A new Frayed Thread becomes a random Thread when used or vendored.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The majority of Scarab sources throughout the game instead now grants a number of Threads.

value.text: Heroic Tragedy (the Kalguuran Timeless jewel) now drops from Olroth, Origin of the Fall. The Forgotten Afarud Commander no longer drops it.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.

corrections.match: In 3.29 Incubators are gone. Legion's own reward is now Vestigial uniques: you Enshroud a unique armour piece with a crystal that only map Generals drop, then charge it in the Domain of Timeless Conflict until it turns into a different unique that carries a weaker copy of the donor's signature mod. Run it now because Legion is a cheap mapping strategy, and the crystals, emblems and Vestigial results are all things you can sell.

In 3.30 Legion no longer spawns at random in maps. You add it with Legion Threads at the Map Device or by running maps in a Legion Shaped Region. value.title: Content Update 3.30.0 — Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra

corrections.reason: Source for the 3.30 changes.

value.text: All Scarabs are gone, including the five Delirium Scarabs (base, Mania, Paranoia, Neuroses, Delusions). Threads replace Scarabs, but none of the ten Thread types is for Delirium.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place.

value.text: Delirium Orbs no longer add enchantment layers. Each one reforges a Rare map and gives it an explicit mod that makes players Delirious.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Delirium Orbs no longer apply enchantments to Maps. Instead they reforge rare Map items with an explicit modifier making players in the area Delirious.

value.text: More orbs of the same type add up to 100%. Using an orb of a different type resets the percentage, so a map holds one reward type.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Applying multiple Delirium Orbs of the same type will add to the current Delirious percentage, up to 100%.

value.text: An orbed map gives 1 reward of the orb's type plus 1 more for every 20% Delirious.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Delirium Orbed Maps have one reward of the specified type and an additional reward of that type for every 20% Delirious Percentage in the area.

value.text: New orbs cannot be used on old maps that still carry Delirium layers.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Delirium Orbs cannot be used on legacy Maps that have layers of Delirium applied.

value.text: Skittering Delirium Orb is renamed Threaded Delirium Orb and pays Threads instead of Scarabs.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Skittering Delirium Orb has been renamed to Threaded Delirium Orb, and now grants Thread rewards (previously Scarabs).

value.text: Fragmented Delirium Orb is removed. Existing ones became Threaded orbs, and old Fragmented-enchanted maps give Thread rewards.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Fragmented Delirium Orb has been removed. Existing Fragmented Delirium Orbs will be converted to Threaded Delirium Orbs.

value.text: Rare maps can roll a new suffix, "Area contains a Mirror of Delirium". It only rolls on Rare maps and shows in a different colour.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The above Modifiers can only be rolled on Rare Maps, and display in a different colour to regular Map modifiers.

value.text: The Atlas tree was rebuilt. Delirium Mirrors now only have clusters that raise the chance of a mirror; the 3.29 reward notables (Imagined Pursuits, Screaming Whispers, Delusions of Persecution and the rest) are not described any more.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Tertiary League mechanics, such as Beyond, Buried Sentinels, Delirium Mirrors, Mirage, and the Viridian Wildwood now only have Atlas Passive clusters that increase the chance for that mechanic to randomly appear in Maps.

value.text: Unending Nightmare is not on the list of removed keystones, but the notes do not say it survived the tree rework. Check the new tree.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following Keystone Atlas Passives have been removed: Crop Rotation, Endless Tide, Lucid Dreams, Meticulous Appraiser, Refiner's Bargain, and Synthesised Stability.

value.text: Deceptive and Templar Astrolabes are removed. Old ones became Cryptic Astrolabes, which you use or vendor for a random other Astrolabe.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Templar, Fruiting and Deceptive Astrolabes have been removed. Pre-existing items have been converted to a Cryptic Astrolabe which can be used or vendored to grant a random other Astrolabe.

value.text: Mirror fog spreads much faster at the start, and fog lasts longer before it fades. These mirror buffs are stronger at higher area levels.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The fog wave from Mirrors of Delirium expands much faster at the start of Delirium encounters.

value.text: Delirious monsters drop Delirium Orbs and Cluster Jewels more often.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Increased the chance for Delirium Orbs and Cluster Jewels to drop from Delirious monsters.

value.text: Delirium monsters drop bigger Simulacrum Splinter stacks on average.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Increased the average stack size of Simulacrum Splinters dropped by Delirium monsters.

value.text: Starting an encounter through a mirror can add 1-3 bonus rewards.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: When starting a Delirium Encounter through a Mirror there is a chance for 1-3 bonus rewards.

value.text: Delirium Bosses in T14+ maps can drop Refracting Fog, no Mirage needed. Refracting Fog is also on the Currency Exchange now.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Refracting Fogs now have a small chance to drop from Delirium Bosses in your Tier 14+ Maps.

value.text: Delirium fog no longer gives monsters Item Quantity; Item Rarity was raised instead. Verisium ore monsters got the same change.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Delirium Fog no longer grants increased Item Quantity to Monsters.

value.text: Item Quantity on map mods is now Atlas Drops at the same values. "Roll X% quantity" now means Atlas Drops.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Replaced Item Quantity on Map Modifiers with Atlas Drops at the same values. This change affects pre-existing items.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Removed the Corruption outcome on non-Unique Maps that rerolls the Map into a Rare Map with 8 Modifiers.

value.text: Cluster Jewel small-passive mods that also give Attack or Cast Speed now share one family, so you cannot roll two of them on one jewel.

value.title: Content Update 3.30.0 — Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra

corrections.reason: Source for the 3.30 changes.

value.title: Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra (official post)

corrections.reason: Source for the 3.30 changes.

value.text: Einhar no longer appears in maps at random. You add him with a Bestiary Thread or by running a map in the Bestiary Shaped Region.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following league mechanics no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas: Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.

value.text: Scarabs were removed and Threads replace them. Bestiary Scarab, Herd, Duplicating and Shadowed Crow are all gone.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place.

value.text: You spend a Bestiary Thread in the Map Device when you open a map, and it adds Bestiary to that map.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Threads can be used when entering an Atlas area through the Map Device to apply the associated League mechanic to that Thread to the area.

value.text: You can spend up to 8 Threads on one map. Each extra Thread raises the chance of strong random Bestiary effects. The notes do not list those effects.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: For each Thread expended, up to a maximum of eight, there are also increasingly higher and higher chances to apply powerful randomised transformative effects to the area related to that League mechanic.

value.text: The Atlas starts with a Bestiary Shaped Region, and maps inside it get free Bestiary Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: There are 10 types of Shaped Region, each associated with a specific type of Thread. By default your Atlas has a Shaped Region of each Thread type on it.

value.text: Each map where you complete the region objective adds 1 free Thread to every other map in that Shaped Region.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Successfully completing the Shaped Region objective in each Map increases the free Thread count by 1 in all other Maps affected by that Shaped Region.

value.text: You cannot run a Shaped Region map without its free Thread, but the map leaves the region after one run (official FAQ).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: This is not possible, but that map will be removed from the shaped region after it is run.

value.text: An Astrolabe now places its Shaped Region on one chosen map, and Astrolabe regions start with more free Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Shaped Regions applied by Astrolabes have a higher base number of free Threads applied to Maps in the Region.

value.text: Searing Exarch altars can make Eldritch monsters or map bosses drop Bestiary Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Searing Exarch Altars now have Modifiers that can cause Eldritch Monsters or Map Bosses to drop Abyss, Expedition, Betrayal, Bestiary and Ultimatum Threads.

value.text: Most things that used to drop Scarabs now drop Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The majority of Scarab sources throughout the game instead now grants a number of Threads.

value.text: Scarabs you already had were turned into a matching Thread or a Frayed Thread.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Existing Scarabs will be converted to either a Thread related to that specific Scarab content, or a Frayed Thread.

value.text: Einhar no longer captures yellow beasts.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Yellow beasts in your Maps are no longer captured by Einhar.

value.text: Yellow beasts still spawn. Einhar stays until every yellow beast is dead and every red beast is captured.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: They are still spawned in the Area, and Einhar will still remain in the area until all yellow beasts have been slain and all red beasts have been captured.

value.text: No beastcraft needs yellow beasts any more. The notes do not give the new beast count for each recipe.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: As Yellow Beasts are no longer be captured, they are no longer a requirement for any Beastcrafting Recipes.

value.text: Beastcrafts that add a modifier to a Flask now cost any Red Beast.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Beastcrafting options to add Modifiers to Flasks now require any Red Beast to use.

value.text: The recipe that made 2 Orbs of Binding now makes 2 Orbs of Regret.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Bestiary Recipe to create a stack of 2 Orbs of Binding instead now creates a stack of 2 Orbs of Regret.

value.text: Bug fix: the beastcraft that adds a modifier to a Rare Map works on maps again.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Fixed a bug where the Bestiary craft to add a Modifier to a Rare Map was not usable on Maps.

value.text: Bug fix: Talismans from Red Beasts with rare monster modifiers are no longer turned into other items.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Fixed some bonus drops from Monsters, such as Talismans on Red Beasts, being unintentionally converted to other items where the Monster had Rare Monster Modifiers.

corrections.reason: Source for the 3.30 changes.

value.text: Scarabs were removed from the game and replaced by a new item type, Threads. Every scarab reward, pool and price in this guide is from 3.29.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place.

value.text: Eater of Worlds altars can now make Eldritch monsters or the map boss drop Breach, Legion, Blight, Ritual or Incursion Threads.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Eater of Worlds Altars now have Modifiers that can cause Eldritch Monsters or Map Bosses to drop Breach, Legion, Blight, Ritual or Incursion Threads.

value.text: Searing Exarch altars can now make Eldritch monsters or the map boss drop Abyss, Expedition, Betrayal, Bestiary or Ultimatum Threads. Several of these were Eater scarab families in 3.29.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Searing Exarch Altars now have Modifiers that can cause Eldritch Monsters or Map Bosses to drop Abyss, Expedition, Betrayal, Bestiary and Ultimatum Threads.

value.text: The upside that duplicated dropped Scarabs now duplicates dropped Threads instead.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Eldritch Altar Modifiers that granted a chance for Scarabs dropped by slain Enemies to be Duplicated, instead now apply to Threads.

value.text: The increased Item Quantity upside was removed, so any advice to take quantity first is out of date.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Eldritch and Memory Trace Altars that granted increased Quantity of Items found have been removed.

value.text: The Item Rarity upside is now 10-20% (was 15-30%).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Eldritch Altars can now grant 10-20% increased Rarity of Items found in this Area (previously 15-30%).

value.text: Currency drops now depend on rarity: the more Item Rarity a monster has, the better the currency it drops.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: What this amounts to is the more Item Rarity a monster has, the better the Currency items it drops.

value.text: Official FAQ: Item Rarity on player gear does not improve currency drops. Only rarity from other sources does.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: No it will not. Only rarity from non-player-gear sources will affect this.

value.text: Most valuable currency now comes from Rare and Unique monsters, the group that map-boss altar options target.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: As a result, a much greater percentage of valuable currency items you find will now be coming from Rare and Unique Monsters.

value.text: Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual and Ultimatum no longer appear in maps at random. Altar strategies built around Breach, Expedition or beasts now need the matching Thread.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following league mechanics no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas: Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.

value.text: You spend Threads at the Map Device to add their league mechanic to an area.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Threads can be used when entering an Atlas area through the Map Device to apply the associated League mechanic to that Thread to the area.

value.text: The Atlas tree was completely rebuilt. The Light of Dawn, Word of the Exarch, The Shadow of Hunger, Rampant Growth and the other node names in this guide come from the 3.29 tree and need re-checking.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Atlas Passive Tree has been completely reworked. You now begin at the centre of the tree, and head outwards.

value.text: Six Atlas keystones were removed. Wrath of the Cosmos and Eldritch Gaze are not on the list, but the notes do not confirm their 3.30 text.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following Keystone Atlas Passives have been removed: Crop Rotation, Endless Tide, Lucid Dreams, Meticulous Appraiser, Refiner's Bargain, and Synthesised Stability.

value.text: All scarab-related Atlas clusters were replaced with Thread clusters.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: All Scarab related Atlas Passive clusters have been replaced with Thread related clusters.

value.text: Defeating the Searing Exarch or the Eater of Worlds now gives 2 Atlas skill points each (was 1).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: is now 2 Atlas Skill points and 2 Atlas Respec points (previously 1 Atlas Skill point and 2 Atlas Respec points).

value.text: The Atlas passive point maximum rose to 150 (was 138), so 3.29 altar trees no longer match.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The total number of Atlas Passive Skill Points you can earn has been increased to 150 (previously 138).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Replaced Item Quantity on Map Modifiers with Atlas Drops at the same values. This change affects pre-existing items.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Each percentage of increased Atlas Drops increases the quantity of Maps and Threads found in the area by 1%.

value.title: Content Update 3.30.0 — Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra

corrections.reason: Source for the 3.30 changes.

value.text: Weeping essences no longer appear on monsters in yellow or red maps, and Wailing essences no longer appear in red maps (Ruthless is not affected).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: In Yellow and Red Maps Weeping Essences no longer generate on Monsters, and in Red Maps Wailing Essences no longer generate on Monsters. These changes do not affect Ruthless.

value.text: The average number of essences on each imprisoned monster now scales with the map's Atlas Drops.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The average number of Essences on Imprisoned Monsters in Maps now scales with Atlas Drop scaling on your Map.

value.text: Item Quantity on map mods is now Atlas Drops, at the same values. Roll maps for Atlas Drops to get more essences.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Replaced Item Quantity on Map Modifiers with Atlas Drops at the same values. This change affects pre-existing items.

value.text: The Essence atlas clusters were reworked and new ones added. Prolific Essence, Crystal Lattice, Amplified Energies, Crystal Resonance and Crystalline Carapaces are 3.29 nodes, and the notes do not confirm them for 3.30.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Atlas Passive clusters related to Secondary League mechanics have been reworked, and new clusters have been added. This includes Essence, Harvest, Mercenaries, Ore Deposits, Rogue Exiles, Shrines, Strongboxes, and Torment.

value.text: The whole Atlas tree was rebuilt and now starts from the centre, so the 3.29 Maxroll planners (o3n7w034, qzn97032) no longer apply.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Atlas Passive Tree has been completely reworked. You now begin at the centre of the tree, and head outwards.

value.text: The Atlas tree now has up to 150 points, up from 138.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The total number of Atlas Passive Skill Points you can earn has been increased to 150 (previously 138).

value.text: Many old scarab effects moved into the new tree, but the notes do not say which Essence Scarab effects survived.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Many effects that previously existed on Scarabs have been partially or fully absorbed by the new Core Atlas Passive Tree.

value.text: The keystones Refiner's Bargain and Synthesised Stability, both used in the Corrupted high-investment tree, were removed.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following Keystone Atlas Passives have been removed: Crop Rotation, Endless Tide, Lucid Dreams, Meticulous Appraiser, Refiner's Bargain, and Synthesised Stability.

value.text: The Delve and Heist atlas clusters are gone, so the essence trees can no longer take Frantic Mining, Secret Stash and similar nodes.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Atlas Passive clusters related to Delve and Heist have been removed.

value.text: Smuggler's Caches and Sulphite no longer spawn at random in maps.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Smuggler's Caches and Sulphite Deposits no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas.

value.text: The Bestiary and Ritual atlas clusters in the Deafening tree were reworked.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: All Atlas Passive clusters related to Primary League mechanics have been reworked. This includes Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.

value.text: Shaped Regions no longer give other maps bonus modifiers, so the old Shaping notables in the Corrupted high-investment tree come from the old system.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Completing Shaped Region objectives no longer grants other Maps in that Shaped Region bonus modifiers.

value.text: New essence: Essence of Trickery. The notes do not say what it does or where it comes from.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Added a new Essence, Essence of Trickery.

value.text: The Essence Stash Tab now has slots for Essence of Desolation and Essence of Trickery.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Added the Essence of Desolation and Essence of Trickery to the Essence Stash Tab.

value.text: Essence of Desolation can now be traded on the Currency Exchange.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following items have been added to the Currency Exchange: The Black Barya, Dextral Catalyst, Essence of Desolation, Refracting Fog, and Sinistral Catalyst.

value.text: The Vaal Orb vendor recipe is cheaper: 5 Vaal Skill Gems and no Sacrifice Fragment.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Vendor Recipe for a Vaal Orb now requires 5 Vaal Skill Gems (previously 7 Vaal Skill Gems and a Sacrifice Fragment).

value.text: The Horticrafting Station, used to reroll essences, now unlocks after your first Sacred Flora encounter.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Horticrafting Station hideout decoration will now unlock the first time you complete a Sacred Flora encounter.

value.text: Ore Deposits in maps give 50% more base ore.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.

corrections.quote: Atlas Passive clusters related to Secondary League mechanics have been reworked, and new clusters have been added. This includes Essence, Harvest, Mercenaries, Ore Deposits, Rogue Exiles, Shrines, Strongboxes, and Torment.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Atlas Passive Tree has been completely reworked. You now begin at the centre of the tree, and head outwards.

value.text: Finishing a Verisium Outcrop channel gives a 30-second Verisium Infusion buff: more experience and a bonus chance for monsters to drop Thaumaturgic Dust.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The power of the Buff scales up the longer you channel on the Verisium Outcrop.

value.text: Monsters from Verisium encounters no longer get increased Item Quantity.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Monsters spawned from Verisium Ore Encounters no longer get increased Item Quantity.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Amber Blood buff causes Gold dropped from slain enemies to have a chance to be duplicated.

value.text: Sulphite and Smuggler's Caches no longer spawn at random in maps.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Smuggler's Caches and Sulphite Deposits no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas.

value.text: Several specific maps now always have Sulphite Veins.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Several specific Maps on the Atlas now always spawn Sulphite Veins, or Smuggler's Caches or have a chance to contain a chest with a Forbidden Tome.

value.text: Map Sulphite Veins give more Sulphite (up to 50% more in level 83 maps) and are always guarded by Sulphite Hoarding packs (not in Ruthless).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Increased the amount of Sulphite gained by Sulphite Veins in Maps, up to 50% as much in level 83 Maps.

value.text: Memory Altars gained new modifiers for Ore Deposits.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.

value.text: Mechanics that have Threads (including Legion) no longer spawn at random, so there is no need to block them on the Atlas any more.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following league mechanics no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas: Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.

value.text: Corrupting a map can no longer reroll it into an 8-mod rare. The new outcome adds 2 explicit mods, up to 9. This ends the 8-mod Nightmare/Originator map sales from Kalguuran map farming.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Removed the Corruption outcome on non-Unique Maps that rerolls the Map into a Rare Map with 8 Modifiers.

value.text: Rog's prefix/suffix reroll deals now reroll 1, 3 or 5 times (was 3, 6 or 10).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.

value.text: A recombined item now takes the item level of the chosen base, not the average of both.

value.title: Content Update 3.30.0 — Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra

corrections.reason: Source for the 3.30 changes.

value.title: Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra (official post)

corrections.reason: Source for the 3.30 changes.

value.text: A full rare set with any piece below item level 60 now pays Orbs of Alchemy, not Orbs of Chance. The notes do not restate the amounts.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Vendoring a full set of Rare items, with at least one of the items being below level 60 now returns Orbs of Alchemy instead of Orbs of Chance.

value.text: Two rare items with the same name now sell for a Chaos Orb (was an Orb of Chance, or an Orb of Alchemy with quality).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Vendoring 2 Rare items with the same name now grants a Chaos Orb (previously an Orb of Chance or Orb of Alchemy)

value.text: Three rare items with the same name now sell for an Exalted Orb (was an Orb of Alchemy, or a Regal Orb with quality).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: vendoring 3 Rare items with the same name now grants an Exalted Orb (previously an Orb of Alchemy or Regal Orb)

value.text: The same-name rare recipes ignore quality now, so the 20%-quality versions are gone.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: These vendor recipes no longer take into account the Quality of the input items.

value.text: The Vaal Orb recipe now needs 5 Vaal skill gems and no fragment (was 7 gems plus a Sacrifice fragment).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The Vendor Recipe for a Vaal Orb now requires 5 Vaal Skill Gems (previously 7 Vaal Skill Gems and a Sacrifice Fragment).

value.text: One normal, one magic, one rare and one unique item of the same base now pay 1 Orb of Chance (was 5).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Vendoring a Normal, Magic, Rare and Unique item of the same base type now awards 1 Orb of Chance (previously 5).

value.text: One new vendor recipe was added. The notes do not say what it is.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Added a new Vendor Recipe.

value.text: Orbs of Chance are much rarer, and vendors no longer sell them.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Orbs of Chance are now much rarer, due to becoming much more effective at resulting in Unique items, and are no longer offered by Vendors.

value.text: Orbs of Chance (and the bench craft that rerolls rarity) are much more likely to make a Unique item.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Significantly increased the chances to get a Unique Item from an Orb of Chance, or the crafting bench option to reroll the rarity of a non-Unique item.

value.text: Strongboxes can no longer roll Contains Mirrored Items or Contains Identified Items, so they no longer supply mirrored same-name pairs.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Strongboxes can no longer roll Contains Identified Items or Contains Mirrored Items.

value.text: Sacrifice and Mortal Fragments were removed. Existing Sacrifice Fragments stay but do nothing.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Sacrifice and Mortal Fragments have been removed. Existing Mortal Fragments will be converted to Royal Visages upon logging in, while Sacrifice Fragments will remain but have no functionality.

value.text: Scarabs were removed, so the 3-scarabs-for-a-random-scarab recipe is gone. Threads replace Scarabs.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place.

value.text: New Frayed Thread currency: use it or sell it to a vendor for a random Thread.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Added a new Currency Item, Frayed Thread which can be used to grant a random Thread, or vendored for a random Thread.

value.text: Skill gems with a starting level requirement of 28-33 now sell for an Orb of Alteration (was an Orb of Chance).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Skill Gems with a starting level requirement between level 28 and level 33 now sell for an Orb of Alteration (previously an Orb of Chance).

value.text: Skill gems with a starting level requirement of 34-37 now sell for an Orb of Alchemy (was an Orb of Chance).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Skill Gems with a starting level requirement between level 34 and level 37 now sell for an Orb of Alchemy (previously an Orb of Chance).

value.text: Divine Vessels (from the Divine Orb + 5 flasks recipe) are now a currency used on maps and stack to 20. The notes do not change the recipe.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Divine Vessels are now Currency items that can be used on Maps to apply the Deified Enchantment Modifier.

value.text: A new bench craft turns every socket white for an Orb of Scouring. Doing this to an item stops it from counting for the RGB Chromatic recipe.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Added a new Crafting Bench option to set all Sockets on an item to be White for a cost of an Orb of Scouring

value.text: High-level Gambler gear has fewer sockets and links, so it is a worse source of 6-socket and 6-link vendor items.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: At high level, equipment purchased from the Gambler has less Modifier Tier Rating as well as fewer Sockets and Socket Links than before.

value.text: Vendors now sell an Orb of Transmutation for an Orb of Augmentation (was Portal Scrolls).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Orbs of Transmutation are now purchasable for an Orb of Augmentation (previously Portal Scrolls).

value.text: Buying an Orb of Scouring from a vendor costs 4 Orbs of Fusing (was 4 Orbs of Chance).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Orbs of Scouring now cost 4 Orbs of Fusing (previously 4 Orbs of Chance)

value.text: Vendor shops no longer ask for an extra Orb of Chance on unidentified rares. Magic amulets now cost 2 Orbs of Alteration.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Unidentified Rare items sold by vendors no longer require an Orb of Chance along with that item's normal cost.

value.text: Kirac's and Whakano's shops are now priced in Alchemy or Transmutation instead of Orbs of Chance. For example, rare maps now cost an extra Orb of Alchemy.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Rare Maps sold by Kirac now cost an additional Orb of Alchemy (previously 3 Orbs of Chance).

value.text: The official FAQ confirms the Hyrri's Bite vendor recipe still needs an Orb of Chance.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Given the change to Orb of Chance drop rate will the Hyrri's Bite vendor recipe still require an Orb of Chance?

value.title: Content Update 3.30.0 — Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra

corrections.reason: Source for the 3.30 changes.

value.text: All Scarabs were removed, including the four Trarthan Scarabs (base, Infamy, Renown, Surprising Alliances). Threads took their place, but none of the ten Thread types is for Mercenaries, so the 3.29 Infamy + Renown rush can no longer be set up.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Scarabs have been removed from the game. A new item type, Threads, have been added in their place.

value.text: Trarthan Scarabs you already own are converted to a Thread or a Frayed Thread; the notes do not say which.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Existing Scarabs will be converted to either a Thread related to that specific Scarab content, or a Frayed Thread.

value.text: Warrants are no longer used with a map. A Warrant opens portals to the Proving Grounds on the Atlas, where you rematch that Mercenary.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Mercenary Warrants are no longer fragments you use alongside a Map. Instead they can be used to open portals to the Proving Grounds area on the Atlas

value.text: The Atlas tree was rebuilt (start in the centre, 150 points) and the Mercenary cluster reworked. The notes name no new nodes, so every 3.29 Mercenary node in this guide is unconfirmed.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Atlas Passive clusters related to Secondary League mechanics have been reworked, and new clusters have been added. This includes Essence, Harvest, Mercenaries, Ore Deposits, Rogue Exiles, Shrines, Strongboxes, and Torment.

value.text: Scarab Atlas clusters became Thread clusters, so 3.29 stats such as Minor Fiefdoms' Trarthan Scarab bonus are gone.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: All Scarab related Atlas Passive clusters have been replaced with Thread related clusters.

value.text: Many old Scarab effects moved, partly or fully, into the Atlas tree. The notes do not say whether Infamy or Renown are among them.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Many effects that previously existed on Scarabs have been partially or fully absorbed by the new Core Atlas Passive Tree.

value.text: Mercenaries still spawn at random in maps; they are not on the list of ten mechanics that lost their random spawn.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: The following league mechanics no longer have a random chance to spawn in Map areas: Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Breach, Blight, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, and Ultimatum.

value.text: Hired Mercenaries now have -30% to all Resistances in level 46-67 areas and -60% in level 68+ areas and hideouts.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: They receive -30% to all Resistances in level 46-67 Areas, and -60% to all Resistances in level 68+ Areas and Hideouts.

value.text: Hired Mercenaries deal less Attack Damage at high levels: up to 20% less at level 83.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Hired Mercenaries now have lower Attack Damage scaling at high levels, dealing up to 20% less Attack Damage at level 83.

value.text: Hired Mercenaries get less Damage Reduction from levelling at high levels.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Hired Mercenaries now have lower Damage Reduction scaling at high levels.

value.text: Hired Mercenaries get more base Life and more increased maximum Life as they level.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Hired Mercenaries now get more additional base Life scaling with level, and more increased Maximum Life scaling with level.

value.text: Mercenaries can no longer equip Kalandra's Touch or spawn with it.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Mercenaries can no longer equip or spawn with the Kalandra's Touch Unique Ring.

value.text: Untouched Soul's empty-socket modifiers only count the player's items, so it does nothing on a Mercenary.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Modifiers on the Untouched Soul Unique Amulet now only apply to empty Sockets for Items Equipped to the Player, meaning they no longer function on Mercenaries.

value.text: Screams of the Desiccated's Shrine-buff modifiers only apply to the player, not a Mercenary.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Modifiers on the Screams of the Desiccated Unique Belt that grant Shrine Buffs while affected by no Flasks now only apply to the Player, meaning they no longer function on Mercenaries.

value.text: Mercenary support penalties removed: Ailment Damage supports no longer have 30% less hit damage, Brutality supports no longer block Chaos or Elemental damage, and Trap and Mine Damage supports no longer have 25% less throwing speed.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Ailment Damage Supports on Mercenaries no longer have Supported Skills deal 30% less Damage with Hits.

value.text: Mercenary Pulverise now gives 25% more Melee Area damage (was 20%); Lesser Pulverise 20% (was 15%) and 25% increased area (was 15%).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Pulverise Support on Mercenaries now has Supported Skills deal 25% more Melee Area Damage (previously 20%).

value.text: Mercenary Greater Brutality now gives up to 25% more Physical damage (was 30%); Greater Trap and Mine Damage up to 25% (was 30%).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Greater Brutality Support on Mercenaries now has Supported Skills deal up to 25% more Physical Damage (previously 30%).

value.text: Kinetic Blast on hired Mercenaries now has 150% Arcane Might (was 200%), matching the player gem.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Adjusted Kinetic Blast on Hired Mercenaries to have 150% Arcane Might, matching the player version of the Skill (previously 200%).

value.text: Luminary's Golden Glory now applies Light Radius to your Mercenary's Link buff effect at 50% of its value (was 100%).

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Increased and Reduction to Light Radius also apply to Effect of your Link Skill Buffs on your Mercenary at 50% of their value (previously 100%).

value.text: Unofficial (Maxroll): Luminary builds that use the Mercenary as the main damage dealer are nerfed.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Luminaries that focus on Mercenaries as their damage dealer are nerfed

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Fixed a bug where Eldritch modifiers that only applied while a Unique Monster or Pinnacle Boss was in your Presence were always applying when on a Minion or a Mercenary.

value.text: Memory Altars have new modifiers for Mercenaries.

corrections.reason: 3.30 patch notes.
corrections.quote: Added new Memory Altar modifiers for Ore Deposits, Mercenaries, Beyond, Sentinel, the Viridian Wildwood and Mirage.
